usage: 炒菜心 is used as a noun to refer to a specific vegetable dish made by stir-frying choy sum.
It can be used as the direct object in sentences, like 'I want to eat 炒菜心.'
炒菜心 can appear in menus and food ordering contexts to specify this dish.
It is commonly paired with verbs like 'eat', 'cook', or 'order' when talking about meals.
炒菜心 is a common dish so it often appears in daily conversation about food.
